claim: Soil Type is a categorical predictor; numeric class codes must not be interpreted as ordered continuous values, and predictions for classes with weak or no sample support require explicit warning.
conditions: The project represents soil classes with dummy variables and groups locations not covered by the soil polygon as Other.
limitations: Other may combine heterogeneous causes such as outside coverage, unmapped soil and topology gaps; it is not a pedological class.
recommended_action: Use categorical encoding, report sample counts by class and compare PC_ONLY with PC_PLUS_SOIL using nested spatial validation.
not_allowed_action: Do not use the raw soil class code as a continuous covariate or assume that Other is a homogeneous soil class.
